title: The Host finally scores, and the Speculatores fall
html:
Battle Round 3

The Host finally scores, and the Speculatores fall

VP
20:2
Units standing
7:6
HP on the field
80:78

Commentary

  1. Command

    The Host spends 2 CP on Double Time for the Archistrategos and keeps IRON GRIP (7 OC on one objective). The Cohort spends nothing and keeps FORWARD PRESENCE (a unit within 3 squares of the enemy HQ). The Host's Mana reaches 17, still unspent.

  2. Movement

    Covenant Levies 1 push onto the east objective at (13,6). Legionnaire Squad 2 Falls Back to the south edge of the same objective (13,8) and keeps a foot in it; the Field Gun's Overwatch misses it. Covenant Levies 2 and the Hospitallers drift towards the lost west objective, and the Archistrategos with his Knight-Apostles turns west to (5,3), away from the empty centre.

  3. Action

    Levies 1 shoot the Speculatores, who had missed them on Overwatch, and destroy them: 6 HP, all three models. Legionnaire Squad 3 raises Shield Wall and the Centurion issues a Move Order.

  4. Scoring

    The east objective stays the Cohort's, OC 10 to 7, and hinges on Legionnaire Squad 2 alone. But the Levies' 7 OC there is exactly what IRON GRIP asks, so the Host scores its first VP: 2 (and 1 CP), all of it the Levies'. The Cohort adds 6: both flanks, and 2 for the standard, now held by the Chiron alone. 20–2.
